15. (1) The Commission shall have the following
functions:

(a) to advise the Minister on all matters relating to
securities and futures contract industries;

(b) to regulate the issue of securities;

(c) to regulate the designation of futures contracts;

(d) to regulate the take;overs and mergers of
companies;

(e) to regulate all matters relating to unit trust
schemes;

(f) to be responsible for supervising and monitoring
the activities of any exchange, clearing house
and central depository;

(g) to take all reasonable measures to safeguard the
interest of persons dealing in securities or
trading in futures contracts;

(h) to promote and encourage proper conduct
amongst members of the exchanges and all
registered persons;
